messages:
sara: Quick sync — pricing/packaging rollout dependencies. Need a TL;DR of owners/blockers for metering adapter, billing API changes, quota gating, and contract constraints. Can ppl reply with one-line status + next step? Planning cross-team readout tomorrow.
kevin: Metering adapter PR `#789` is open, integration tests failing on billing schema change. Next: wait for billing schema merge or add shim. ETA if blocking is removed: ~1 day. @mike can you confirm schema ETA?
mike: Billing team: blocked by contract edge cases — tax code mapping and existing-contract billing dates. I need a small sample of affected contracts to sign off. I can do schema merge after contract ok. I can add a feature flag for new rates though.
alex: Product note — we should consider a temporary fallback to legacy metering to avoid any billing gaps for customers during the schema window. Low-risk flag rollout.
olivia: From contracts: I can review samples today but we cannot change invoice dates for signed contracts without explicit amendment. Share examples and which customers are impacted. Also flag any contract language that ties pricing dates to plan renewal.
sara: Uploaded a sanitized sample bundle to Drive: <https://drive.redwood/safe-samples>. Action items: (1) olivia to confirm whether amendment needed; (2) mike to surface flag + migration plan; (3) kevin to add shim if needed. Owners: metering=kevin, billing=mike, contracts=olivia, product=sara.
mike: I can implement migration flag and a script to backfill mapping for affected contracts. Will open `#790` with tests. Note: we need 24h customer notice before flipping for prod billing basis.
kevin: If we rely on a shim instead of schema change we lose some batch efficiencies but preserves continuity. I can add quota-gating config in Dedicated for canary, estimate 2d to validate. For canary we should route 10% traffic and monitor token-level cost + latency.
sara: OK — plan for readout: list blockers (contracts sign-off, schema merge), and propose canary Thu 10:00 UTC after PRs merged. @deploy-bot please schedule canary and remind approvals.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled request queued for Thu 10:00 UTC — requires approvals from billing and contracts. Please add approvers in PR. :thumbsup:
alex: Quick CR ping — mike/kevin, once PRs open I’ll prioritize review. Small ask: add a short rollback playbook in PR description so SRE can act fast.
mike: Will include rollback steps and a migration-runbook snippet in `#790`.
sara: Thanks all — I'll run this readout tomorrow and include these owners/blockers. If anything slips, ping here. :rocket:
